title: Phrase-by-phrase study guide
status: Editorial navigation aid — canonical text remains unchanged

phrases.he: אשרי תמימי דרך
phrases.en: Happy are those whose way is perfect
phrases.info: The opening describes the happiness of wholeness and a straight path.
phrases.enMatch: Happy are those whose way is perfect

phrases.he: ההולכים בתורת ה'
phrases.en: who walk in the Torah of Hashem
phrases.info: The teaching will explain how walking through Torah leads to grace and accepted prayer.
phrases.enMatch: who walk in the Torah of Hashem

phrases.he: כי על ידי התורה נתקבלים כל התפלות וכל הבקשות
phrases.en: Through Torah, all prayers and requests are accepted
phrases.info: This is the teaching’s central promise and the result whose inner process the following sections explain.
phrases.enMatch: Through this, all prayers and requests are accepted

phrases.he: והחן והחשיבות של ישראל נתעלה ונתרומם
phrases.en: The grace and importance of Israel are elevated
phrases.info: Torah restores Israel’s true chen—grace and standing—before those from whom spiritual or material help is needed.
phrases.enMatch: the grace [חֵן] and importance [חֲשִׁיבוּת] of Israel are elevated

phrases.he: חן וחשיבות האמיתי של ישראל נפל
phrases.en: The true grace and importance of Israel have fallen
phrases.info: The Rebbe identifies exile as a displacement of authentic Jewish grace and importance.
phrases.enMatch: the true grace and importance of Israel have fallen

phrases.he: אילת אהבים ויעלת חן
phrases.en: A loving doe and a gazelle that raises grace
phrases.info: The verse’s expression יעלת חן is read as Torah elevating and bestowing chen upon those who study it.
phrases.enMatch: a loving doe and a gazelle that raises grace

phrases.he: צריך תמיד להסתכל בהשכל, של כל דבר
phrases.en: One must always contemplate the intellect in every matter
phrases.info: Every encounter contains an inner wisdom; the first task is to look for it rather than remain at the surface.
phrases.enMatch: one must contemplate the intellect in every matter

phrases.he: ולקשר עצמו אל החכמה והשכל שיש בכל דבר
phrases.en: Connect oneself to the wisdom and intellect in every matter
phrases.info: Recognition is not enough: the person connects to that wisdom so the situation itself becomes a path toward Hashem.
phrases.enMatch: connect himself to the wisdom [חָכְמָה] and intellect present in every matter

phrases.he: כי השכל הוא אור גדול ומאיר לו בכל דרכיו
phrases.en: The intellect is a great light that illuminates all his paths
phrases.info: Wisdom functions as guidance and illumination throughout a person’s ways.
phrases.enMatch: the intellect is a great light that shines for him in all his ways

phrases.he: וזה בחינת יעקב
phrases.en: This is the aspect of Jacob
phrases.info: Jacob embodies wisdom because he received the birthright—reishit, the beginning, which is associated with chochmah.
phrases.enMatch: This is the aspect of Jacob

phrases.he: החכמה והשכל הוא החיות של כל דבר
phrases.en: Wisdom and intellect are the vitality of every matter
phrases.info: The letter ח is linked with chiyut, vitality: wisdom is presented not merely as information but as the life within a thing.
phrases.enMatch: wisdom and intellect are the vitality of every matter

phrases.he: אי אפשר לזכות אליו כי אם על ידי בחינת נון שהוא בחינת מלכות
phrases.en: It can be attained only through nun, the aspect of kingship
phrases.info: The immense light of intellect requires a receptive vessel: nun, identified here with holy Malchut.
phrases.enMatch: it is impossible to attain it except through the aspect of נוּן, which is the aspect of Malchut (Kingship)

phrases.he: כי הלבנה אין לה אור מעצמה כי אם מה שמקבלת מהשמש
phrases.en: The moon has no light of its own except what it receives from the sun
phrases.info: The moon models Malchut’s receptivity; it receives from the sun, which represents wisdom.
phrases.enMatch: the moon has no light of its own, only what it receives from the sun

phrases.he: מי שאינו מקשר עצמו אל השכל והחכמה והחיות, שיש בכל דבר
phrases.en: One who does not connect to the intellect, wisdom, and vitality in every matter
phrases.info: This is contrasted with Esau, who despised the birthright and therefore rejected the path of wisdom.
phrases.enMatch: one who does not connect himself to the intellect, wisdom, and vitality in every matter

phrases.he: היצר טוב נקרא "מסכן וחכם"
phrases.en: The good inclination is called poor and wise
phrases.info: The good inclination parallels holy Malchut: humble and receptive, receiving from wisdom rather than claiming independent power.
phrases.enMatch: the good inclination is called מִסְכֵּן וְחָכָם—poor and wise

phrases.he: ויצר הרע נקרא "מלך זקן וכסיל"
phrases.en: The evil inclination is called an old and foolish king
phrases.info: The opposing kingship refuses wisdom and embodies the fool who does not desire understanding.
phrases.enMatch: The evil inclination is called מֶלֶךְ זָקֵן וּכְסִיל—an old and foolish king

phrases.he: וצריך כל אחד לתן כח לבחינת מלכות דקדשה
phrases.en: Each person must give strength to holy Malchut
phrases.info: The conflict is practical: a person must empower receptive, holy kingship against the opposing kingship.
phrases.enMatch: Everyone must strengthen the aspect of holy Malchut

phrases.he: על ידי התורה, שהוא עוסק בכח
phrases.en: Through Torah in which he engages with strength
phrases.info: Forceful, committed Torah study is the stated means of strengthening holy Malchut and subduing the evil inclination.
phrases.enMatch: Through the Torah, by engaging in it with strength

phrases.he: ונתחבר ונתקשר הח' והנ'
phrases.en: Chet and nun join and connect
phrases.info: Chet—wisdom and vitality—joins nun—Malchut and receptivity—to form חן, chen, grace.
phrases.enMatch: The חֵית and נוּן combine and connect

phrases.he: וכשזה קם, זה נופל
phrases.en: When this one rises, that one falls
phrases.info: As holy Malchut gains power through Torah, the opposing kingship and evil inclination are weakened.
phrases.enMatch: When this one rises, that one falls

phrases.he: עקר מה שאין נתקבלין הבקשות הוא מחמת שאין להדברים חן
phrases.en: Requests are not accepted primarily because the words lack grace
phrases.info: Without chen, words fail to find an entrance into the listener’s heart.
phrases.enMatch: requests are not accepted is that the words lack grace

phrases.he: אבל על ידי התורה
phrases.en: Through Torah, nun and chet join
phrases.info: Torah unites the receptive vessel with wisdom, producing the chen that allows words to be received.
phrases.enMatch: through the Torah, which connects and unites the נוּן and the חֵית

phrases.he: על ידי החן נחקק ונרשם מקום בלב המתבקש
phrases.en: Through grace, a place is engraved in the heart of the one being asked
phrases.info: Chen does not merely make speech pleasant; it carves an inward place where the request can enter.
phrases.enMatch: through grace, a place is engraved and marked in the heart of the one requested

phrases.he: דברי חכמים בנחת נשמעים
phrases.en: The words of the wise are heard in quietness
phrases.info: נחת contains the movement of the teaching: חן joined with ת, the lasting engraved mark, so wise words are heard.
phrases.enMatch: The words of the wise are heard in quietness

phrases.he: יעקב שהוא בחינת השכל כנ"ל, על כן זכה לחן
phrases.en: Jacob, the aspect of intellect, merited grace
phrases.info: Jacob’s identification with wisdom explains why he could transmit chen to his children.
phrases.enMatch: Jacob, who is the aspect of intellect

phrases.he: ודוקא יוסף היה יכול לברכו בחן
phrases.en: Specifically Joseph could bless him with grace
phrases.info: Joseph could bless Benjamin with chen because Joseph most fully embodied Jacob’s quality.
phrases.enMatch: Specifically, Joseph was able to bless with grace

phrases.he: 'בכור' הוא בחינת השכל
phrases.en: Firstborn is the aspect of intellect
phrases.info: Bechor points back to reishit—the beginning—and therefore to chochmah.
phrases.enMatch: firstborn is the aspect of intellect

phrases.he: וזהו 'שורו' - לשון הסתכלות
phrases.en: Shoro is an expression of looking
phrases.info: The word is used to reinforce the active discipline of looking into the inner intellect of every matter.
phrases.enMatch: shoro (his ox) is a language of contemplation

phrases.he: אפלו במקום שהיה אפל וחשך, מאיר לו השכל
phrases.en: Even in a place that was dark, the intellect illuminates for him
phrases.info: The inner wisdom can turn obscurity itself into a route of closeness to Hashem.
phrases.enMatch: even in a place that was dark and obscure. The intellect shines

phrases.he: האי גלא דמטבע לספינתא
phrases.en: This wave that sinks a ship
phrases.info: The Talmudic image introduces the evil inclination’s attempt to sink Israel’s chen and importance.
phrases.enMatch: This wave that sinks a ship

phrases.he: צוציתא דנורא חורתא ברישא
phrases.en: A spark of white fire at its head
phrases.info: The white appearance is deceptive: the harmful force initially presents itself in the appearance of holiness.
phrases.enMatch: a spark of white fire at its head

phrases.he: ומחינן ליה באלותא דחקיק עליה "אהיה אשר אהיה"
phrases.en: We strike it with a club engraved with ‘I Am That I Am’
phrases.info: The engraved Divine Name anticipates the teaching’s identification of the club with Torah and its holy Names.
phrases.enMatch: we strike it with a club engraved with I Am That I Am

phrases.he: גלא - הוא היצר הרע
phrases.en: The wave is the evil inclination
phrases.info: The Rebbe now decodes the Talmudic image directly.
phrases.enMatch: The wave is the evil inclination

phrases.he: היצר הרע רוצה להטביע ולהשפיל, חס ושלום, בחינת החן והחשיבות של ישראל
phrases.en: The evil inclination seeks to sink and lower Israel’s grace and importance
phrases.info: The sinking ship represents an attack on holy Malchut—Israel’s true chen and standing.
phrases.enMatch: the evil inclination seeks to sink and degrade, Heaven forbid, the aspect of grace and importance of Israel

phrases.he: מתחלה היצר הרע מתלבש עצמו במצוות
phrases.en: At first the evil inclination clothes itself in mitzvot
phrases.info: Its first strategy is counterfeit holiness: presenting temptation as though it were a mitzvah.
phrases.enMatch: the evil inclination cloaks itself in mitzvot

phrases.he: אף על פי כן מלאך מזיק הוא
phrases.en: Nevertheless, it is a harmful angel
phrases.info: A white and holy-looking exterior does not change the destructive identity concealed beneath it.
phrases.enMatch: Nevertheless, it is a harmful angel

phrases.he: עקר הכנעתו של היצר הרע הוא על ידי התורה
phrases.en: The primary subjugation of the evil inclination is through Torah
phrases.info: Torah is the engraved club because it is composed of the Names of the Holy One, blessed be He.
phrases.enMatch: the primary subjugation of the evil inclination is through the Torah

phrases.he: אין אדם עובר עברה אלא אם כן נכנס בו רוח שטות
phrases.en: A person transgresses only when a spirit of folly enters him
phrases.info: Sin is framed as madness or folly; Torah drives out that spirit and restores the rule of wisdom.
phrases.enMatch: A person does not commit a transgression unless a spirit of folly enters him

phrases.he: אשרי - לשון הסתכלות
phrases.en: Ashrei is an expression of looking
phrases.info: The closing returns to the opening word and reads it through the teaching’s central practice: attentive contemplation.
phrases.enMatch: Ashrei (happy) is a language of contemplation

phrases.he: תמימי דרך בחינת (בראשית כ״ה:כ״ז): יעקב איש תם
phrases.en: Those perfect in the way correspond to Jacob, a wholesome man
phrases.info: Tamim points to Jacob, who represents the intellect that seeks Hashem within every matter.
phrases.enMatch: Tamimei derech (those whose way is perfect)

phrases.he: על ידי שלומד תורה בכח
phrases.en: Through studying Torah with strength
phrases.info: Strong Torah study empowers nun—holy Malchut—to receive from chet—the intellect.
phrases.enMatch: through studying the Torah with strength

phrases.he: נעשה חן ונתקבלים דבריו
phrases.en: Grace is formed and his words are accepted
phrases.info: The entire chain closes: Torah joins ח and נ into חן, elevates Israel’s true importance, and allows prayers and requests to enter the heart.
phrases.enMatch: grace [חֵן] is formed, and his words are accepted
